title.zh: 将奎松省Gumaca市镇San Pedro村的名称正式变更为Biga村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio San Pedro, Municipality of Gumaca, Province of Quezon, to Biga
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio San Pedro, Municipality of Gumaca, Province of Quezon, to Biga
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio San Pedro, Thị trấn Gumaca, Tỉnh Quezon thành Biga
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ San Pedro, เทศบาล Gumaca, จังหวัด Quezon เป็น Biga
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio San Pedro, Kotamadya Gumaca, Provinsi Quezon menjadi Biga
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio San Pedro, Perbandaran Gumaca, Wilayah Quezon menjadi Biga

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2544_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio San Pedro, Municipality of Gumaca, Province of Quezon, is hereby changed to Biga.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
